items.body:
New Music This Week: AIJOU, Temple Code, The Analog Girl, LAYYI, hongjoin, Boon Hui Lu, ICEBOX & more
Words by Sharvamaya on 29 May 2026
Last updated on 29 May 2026
120
Spins

Every week, many local musicians release new music that flies under the radar. This week, we have a bumper crop and to bring you the best new music releases from home, we’ve compiled a playlist featuring some of the newest songs out from artists such as AIJOU, Temple Code, The Analog Girl, LAYYI, hongjoin, Boon Hui Lu, ICEBOX, Soph T., J.M3, rhyu, Midnight Blu, Annette Lee, DAINASAURS, MARICELLE, ALICIA DC, KIARA, JOYY and Soong.
